# Adapter contract fixtures

## Dify session detail

`dify_session_detail.json` is generated by actual Python `create_session` and
`get_session` route functions with an isolated in-memory `SessionManager`. The
fixture controls session UUIDs and stored timestamps to make exact comparison
reproducible; it does not add or repair response fields after serialization.
All identities and conversation IDs are synthetic.

`tests/api/test_dify_session_contract_fixture.py` regenerates the response in
memory and asserts exact equality with this checked-in fixture. Run:

```sh
uv run --all-packages --extra test pytest -q --no-cov tests/api/test_dify_session_contract_fixture.py
```

To inspect regenerated JSON (review before replacing the fixture):

```sh
uv run --all-packages --extra test python -m tests.api.test_dify_session_contract_fixture
```

`web/src/pages/playground/hooks/difySessionContract.test.ts` always consumes the
fixture in normal Web tests. It executes the real session API functions, Dify
conversation preparation, and Playground hooks with controlled transport. A
Web-only pass does **not** mean Python was executed; both gates must pass to
verify the cross-language response contract. An external before/after run can
set `DIFY_SESSION_RESPONSES` to freshly generated route JSON without changing
production code.

The response must expose the stored `service_id`, including null for unbound
legacy sessions. Dify keeps strict service matching: missing, null, or foreign
service identity fails before dispatch. Matching sessions start fresh or resume
only their own metadata binding. Identity metadata is persisted before stream
completion, and interruption or persistence failure never causes another invoke.
This fixture gate does not establish native-route, live-provider, database,
authentication-middleware, browser, or listener-based acceptance.
